summary: The prepared base reproduced both reported defects: a forced profiler fraction was bypassed by the compact verify-all cache, and the reported 48-request/640-token packed mRoPE input failed its fixed-width reshape. At the exact candidate commit, the focused regression suite passed, forced fractions reached the real top-k scheduler and produced distinct token totals, and the packed ragged mRoPE implementation matched independent row-wise references on an AMD MI355X for the reported geometry plus 23 adversarial geometries. The candidate changes Python only and preserves the no-force verify-all fast path. No counterexample was found within the directly exercisable contract.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-0b86ff3d3e21/venv/bin/python - <<'PY' # base planner and 48x640 mRoPE reproduction
tests.what_was_measured: The forced-budget planner's dynamic scheduler call count remained zero, and compute_spec_mrope_positions raised RuntimeError: shape '[48, -1]' is invalid for 640 elements.
Candidate regressions and surrounding focused coverage: 37 tests and 18 subtests passed.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-0b86ff3d3e21/venv/bin/python - <<'PY' # independent GPU ragged mRoPE and scheduler adversarial checks
tests.what_was_measured: On AMD MI355X, the reported 48-request, 575-real-token, 640-graph-token mixed-multimodal case and 23 additional ragged/padded cases matched an independent CPU row-wise reference exactly (max absolute error 0). Real top-k runs respected budgets 0, 48, and 112; a near-zero-survival case used 191 of 192 candidates because one cumulative probability fell below the documented survival_eps threshold.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-0b86ff3d3e21/venv/bin/python - <<'PY' # HostConfidenceBudgetPlanner fraction sweep into real GPU top-k scheduler
tests.what_was_measured: Fractions 0.2, 0.4666666666666667, 0.7333333333333333, and 1.0 yielded budgets 38, 89, 140, and 192 and total verify-token counts 86, 137, 188, and 240 respectively.

gpu_evidence: PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 executed the candidate mRoPE and DSpark top-k paths on one AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950); torch.cuda.is_available() was true and explicit synchronization completed.
native_rebuild_reason: The candidate modifies only Python and Python tests/reports; no native, FlyDSL, compiler, or build source changed.
remaining_limitations: The prepared host has one AMD Instinct MI355X (ROCm 7.2), not the reported NVIDIA H20 CUDA 13.0 system, so NVIDIA-specific CUDA Graph execution was not run.

The reported Qwen target and draft checkpoints were unavailable, and the original command requires two GPUs while one assigned GPU was exposed; therefore the full profiling server and HTTP profiler were not launched.

The production planner, budget computation, top-k GPU scheduling, and ForwardBatch mRoPE method were exercised directly, but multi-rank TP behavior and end-to-end latency separation remain environment-unverified.
